headword: {対数関数|たいすうかんすう}

definitions.explanation: In mathematics, a function of the form y = log_a x, the inverse of the exponential function. A standard topic in high-school and university math, used to model growth, decay, and quantities that span many orders of magnitude.

examples.japanese: {対数関数|たいすうかんすう}のグラフを{描|か}く。
examples.english: I draw the graph of a logarithmic function.

examples.japanese: {対数関数|たいすうかんすう}は{指数関数|しすうかんすう}の{逆関数|ぎゃくかんすう}だ。
examples.english: The logarithmic function is the inverse of the exponential function.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}の{数学|すうがく}で{対数関数|たいすうかんすう}の{性質|せいしつ}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: In high-school math I learned the properties of logarithmic functions.

notes:
Compound of {対数|たいすう} (logarithm) + {関数|かんすう} (function). A mathematics term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}{対数関数|たいすうかんすう}: natural logarithmic function
- {対数関数|たいすうかんすう}のグラフ: graph of a logarithmic function
- {対数関数|たいすうかんすう}の{微分|びぶん}: differentiation of a logarithmic function

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指数関数|しすうかんすう}: exponential function — its inverse
- {一次関数|いちじかんすう}: linear function — another basic function type studied alongside it
